strings: The stink of infection has strengthened and worsened. r_c0 mutters about different herbs as m_c watches {PRONOUN/r_c0/object} change yet another poultice that probably won't work.
m_c swears {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} been cleaning it, but {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} wound has begun to fester like week-old prey.
